method: Offline independent installed-package factory/React serialization comparison, wrapper AST inspection, default-context prop probes, and public static/dynamic source graphs. No browser, network or project build.

propSemantics.scope: Original default IconContext only; public source usage is checked below. Browser CSS inheritance/external-use rendering is separate.

graph.scope: Source reachability overapproximates tree-shaken modules. Includes dynamic modules reachable from public routes; excludes private route bodies. Final emitted production chunk bytes require a build/payload audit.

limitations: External SVG use inherits geometry through a browser-managed instance tree; this offline check does not prove browser rendering, currentColor behavior, accessible-name computation or hit testing. Baseline browser fixture QA is separate.
IconContext is intentionally unsupported by the helper. No public reachable IconContext use was found; future providers would require explicit support.
Static source graphs are not a measurement of emitted bundles or production network transfer. Private dynamic route modules are outside this scope.
